title: Vaporwave Guide (Neocities)
lede: A fan-made beginner’s guide to vaporwave on a hot pink page, with a collage of the Windows 95 logo, Game Boys, palms, and Japanese text.
summary: Hot pink page, mint headings, default blue links, and a Windows 95 collage with vertical Japanese text.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Clear: a fan site that describes the genre and uses it too, with a saturated pink ground, a collage of the Windows 95 logo, Game Boys, palms, and drink bottles, and vertical Japanese text. The CSS is plain, so the fingerprint cannot see the style; it lives in the image and the colour.

observed: The whole page is flat hot pink; the title “Vaporwave Guide” and the welcome line are mint green, bold, and underlined.
Six centred links in default blue underlined text list labels, artists, images, albums, a guide, and credits.

A wide collage below shows a glitched Windows 95 logo and wordmark, a column of Game Boy handhelds, fruit-drink bottles, palm trees, blue statues, and vertical pink Japanese text over a pink-and-green sky.
interpretation: It is the style at its most amateur: all of it sits in one pasted image and a background colour. The measurement sees only flat colour and no shadows.

images.alt: Vaporwave Guide home page: hot pink background, mint-green underlined title, a column of blue links, and a collage of the Windows 95 logo, Game Boys, drink bottles, palms, and vertical Japanese text.
